details: Package @pkgship/frpc-linux-amd64@0.71.1 is a platform-specific npm distribution for an frpc binary targeting linux-amd64. No install, preinstall, postinstall, or prepare lifecycle scripts were observed, and no code paths reading installer secrets, performing network exfiltration, fetching remote content for execution, or establishing persistence were observed. The package appears to ship a prebuilt binary artifact as a platform-scoped sub-package, which is the standard pattern for distributing native binaries alongside a parent JS wrapper. Note that frpc is a reverse-proxy / tunneling tool; its runtime capability is exercised only when a user explicitly invokes the binary with their own configuration, not as a consequence of installing this npm package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
